# Lute Diamonds

> Lute Diamonds (Pty) Ltd is a fine jewellery house established in 2006 in Kimberley, South Africa, specialising in certified natural diamonds and Tanzanite gemstones. The company handcrafts rings, pendants, and earrings, and ships internationally to customers across the United Kingdom and Europe.

Lute Diamonds combines ethically sourced precious metals (9k, 14k, and 18k gold in white, yellow, and rose tones) with certified gemstones. Certification is provided by EGLSA (European Gemological Laboratory South Africa) and, for select pieces, GIA (Gemological Institute of America). Tanzanite — a rare blue-violet gemstone found only near Mount Kilimanjaro, Tanzania — is a specialty of the brand alongside natural diamonds. One product line (blue spinel) is explicitly lab-created/synthetic and is disclosed as such, distinct from the brand's natural gemstone pieces.

The business is headquartered at 25 Villiers Street, Kimberley 8301, South Africa, and primarily serves international retail customers in the UK and Europe via its online store, in addition to local South African customers.

## Shipping & Markets

- Primary international markets: United Kingdom and Europe.
- Certification and authenticity documentation accompanies all certified pieces.
- Head office and manufacturing based in South Africa; online store ships internationally.
